current_evidence: The council's 'Validation checklist and sustainability checklist' page links only this Validation Checklist (and the companion Sustainability Checklist, both Feb 2024); the PDF reads 'Version 2 – February 2024'; no newer list or consultation was found by search.

issues.detail: Most of Section 6 (major development local requirements) was not captured. Missing items: 6.2 Affordable housing statement (11+ dwellings or sites over 0.36 ha); 6.7 Broadband statement (all major); 6.10 Electric vehicle charging plan (major with non-residential parking); 6.27 Planning obligations heads of terms (where contributions proposed); 6.28 Planning statement (all major); 6.29 Retail impact assessment (main town centre uses over 500 sq m gross outside a defined centre); 6.32 Transport assessment/statement (per DfT thresholds); 6.35 Viability assessment (where not all contributions can be paid).

More local requirements are absent: 6.1 Aerodrome safeguarding assessment; 5.1/6.3 Air quality assessment (possible exposure above statutory limits, TA thresholds, or EIA development); 5.6/6.8 Contaminated land assessment (known or suspected contamination); 5.12/6.30 Sequential test for main town centre uses or offices outside a defined centre; 6.17 Landscape plans and 6.24 Materials plan (full or reserved matters for major development); 6.18 LVIA and 6.19 Townscape VIA; 6.22 Employment loss statement (Policy ED1 sites).
issues.evidence: Sections 5 and 6, e.g. '5.12 Sequential test - main town centre uses or offices outside a defined centre'

issues.detail: Several local requirements that apply to all applications are missing: 2.8 Community Infrastructure Levy forms (from 1 April 2024; most applications and certain prior approvals); 2.4 Existing and proposed roof plans (roof alterations); 2.6 Levels (new buildings, and householder applications with level changes); 5.3 Bin storage (all applications, including changes of use) / 6.31 Site waste management plan. Note: 5.3 is the minor-development section of the list.
issues.evidence: Section 2 'Local Requirements: Basic Plans and Documents' items 2.4, 2.6, 2.8; item 5.3 Bin storage

issues.detail: Most of the Section 3 householder checklist is missing: 3.2 External wall insulation, 3.3 Dropped kerb, 3.4 Householder plus listed building consent, 3.5 Householder in a Conservation Area, 3.6 Prior approval for larger home extension, and 3.9 Householder affecting trees (tree protection plan where trees are within or next to the site). Grokbot's Householder rows cover only bats, sustainability and energy.
Heritage items missing: 4.4 Archaeological assessment (groundworks that may affect archaeological deposits) and 4.5 Structural survey (full or partial demolition of a listed building).

Outline and Reserved matters are recorded as '(none)'. The source names both: 6.23 Masterplan and 6.26 Parameters plan apply to large-scale major schemes 'especially outline or phased'; 6.11 Energy statement may be deferred to reserved matters for outline; 6.17 Landscape plans and 6.24 Materials plan apply to 'full applications or reserved matters for major development'. All Section 5/6 items apply to outline as well as full.
issues.evidence: 6.17 / 6.24: 'Full applications or reserved matters for major development'

issues.detail: About 17 requirements are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' without the source's minor vs major split. Section 5 covers minor development and Section 6 major development, so thresholds are lost. Examples: Health Impact Assessment (6.16, only large residential or industrial schemes or sites over 1 ha); Travel Plan (6.33, major with travel impacts); Masterplan (6.23, large-scale major, especially outline); Drainage strategy (6.9, all major).
issues.evidence: Section headings: '5. Local Requirements: Minor Development', '6. Local Requirements: Major Development'

issues.detail: 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' is placed under Householder. The source requires an Energy statement only for major development (6.11); householders complete the Sustainability Checklist (3.7). Its excerpt is the 3.8 'roof space or demolition' heading, not an energy trigger.
issues.evidence: 6.11 Energy statement: 'Major development with energy demand'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is placed under Full planning, with an excerpt about an Arboricultural Method Statement. Source 4.3 requires a schedule of works for listed building consent involving structural alterations or demolition.
issues.evidence: 4.3 Schedule of works - 'Listed building consent involving structural alterations or demolition'

issues.detail: 'Demolition in cons area' is recorded as '(none)', but 4.1 Photographic record applies to demolition of a building in a Conservation Area. 'Change of use - prior approval' is also '(none)', although 2.8 CIL forms apply to certain prior approvals.
issues.evidence: 4.1 Photographic record: 'Application for demolition of a listed building or building within a Conservation Area'

issues.detail: 'Floor plans / Elevations' is placed under Advertisement consent, and 'Block plan / Site plan' under Lawful development cert. The excerpts run columns 2.1 and 2.2 together. In the source, 2.1 Block plan applies to built development and advert consent; 2.2 Floor plans applies to built development and LDCs; only 2.3 Elevations applies to adverts.
issues.evidence: 2.1 'All planning applications for built development and applications for advertisement consent'; 2.2 '...applications for existing/proposed certificate of lawful development (where relevant)'

issues.detail: Several excerpts belong to a different requirement. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' runs into the 6.13 Flood Risk Assessment text. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' quotes FRA guidance and the 6.14 floor space heading (source 6.9: all major). 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is FRA guidance plus the 5.8 floor space schedule, not a separate requirement. 'Lighting Assessment' and 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' share one merged excerpt that mixes 5.9, 5.10 and housing-mix text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot EIA excerpt: '...6.13 Flood Risk Assessment All major development; and Flood zone information...'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are fragments with no trigger. Travel Plan: 'accompanied by a Travel Plan.' Noise: 'must be prepared by a qualified acoustician' (source 5.11/6.25: applications raising disturbance issues or noise-sensitive development). Foul Sewage: 'Foul drainage details may also be required.' Housing mix: 'with the housing mix for both market and affordable housing.' (part of the 5.8/6.14 accommodation schedule for major development).
issues.evidence: 5.11/6.25 Noise impact assessment - 'Applications raising disturbance issues or noise-sensitive development'

issues.detail: The Householder 'Ecological Survey' excerpt merges the 3.8 bat triggers with the next heading, '3.9 Householder application affecting trees', so the tree requirement is lost inside the ecology row.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt ends '...3.9 Householder application affecting trees All plans and drawings detailed in Section 2 must be provided;'

issues.detail: Some 'Submission rules' tab items are process and contact text, not requirements: the Planning Portal 10Mb limit, 'Details on how to reduce file sizes are provided by the Planning Portal via this link:', and the instruction to email rbc.planning@rugby.gov.uk. Two drawing-standards items are fragments: '..."Do Not Scale" on them. 1.' and 'All advertisement consent applications; and Applications for Elevation drawings should be drawn...'.
issues.evidence: 'If larger documents need to be submitted they should be provided through a cloud based transfer system or by emailing rbc.planning@rugby.gov.uk'

issues.detail: Telecommunications supplementary information is placed under Full planning. In the source it sits in Section 7 (other application types) as 7.8 Telecommunications applications, which includes telecoms prior approvals.
issues.evidence: 7.8 Telecommunications applications - siting justification and ICNIRP certificate

summary: Grokbot's link is Rugby's current validation checklist (Version 2, February 2024), and the date is correct. The extraction covers only a fraction of the 60+ numbered requirements and misses most of the major-development list (affordable housing, planning statement, transport assessment, CIL, air quality, contamination, etc.) and most householder items. Outline and reserved matters are wrongly shown as having no local requirements, and many trigger excerpts are spliced from neighbouring rows.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
